title.en: What infrastructure window does LZ-60 print?
title.zh: LZ-60 给基建印了哪一扇窗口？

description.en: LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, delivery height 300 m and aggregate 4 cm and below.
description.zh: LZ-60 印了 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。

h1.en: What infrastructure window does LZ-60 print?
h1.zh: LZ-60 给基建印了哪一扇窗口？

directAnswer.en: A diesel pipeline inside 100 m conveying and 300 m delivery height, with stone at 4 cm and below. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 for sites without stable grid power and for rural and infrastructure placement: 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. It is not the Diesel 60 table that shares the code string.
directAnswer.zh: 一段柴油管路，输送在 100 m 内、输送高度在 300 m 内，石子在 4 cm 及以下。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 列为电网不稳以及农村与基建浇筑：145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。它不是共用代号字符串的那张柴油60表。

heading.zh: 这里的 50 m³/h 不是 HBT80-16

body.en: HBT80-16 also prints 50 m³/h, but it is an electric building pump at 110 kW, 120 m horizontal and 360 m delivery height. LZ-60 is the diesel infrastructure row at 145 kW and 100 m conveying. Same output figure, different power and different distance.
body.zh: HBT80-16 也印了 50 m³/h，但它是电动建筑泵：110 kW、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m。LZ-60 是柴油基建行：145 kW、输送 100 m。输送量数字相同，动力和距离不同。

heading.en: When the line is longer or coarser
heading.zh: 管路更长或石子更粗时

body.en: Longer vertical listing at high output is Diesel 120 (150 m / 500 m, 100 m³/h). Coarser than 4 cm, up to 6 cm, is LZ-80 or Diesel 120. A 900 m horizontal line is Electric 80 and needs grid power. LZ-60 does not stretch to those cells.
body.zh: 更高排量的更长垂直列出在柴油120（150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h）。粗于 4 cm、直到 6 cm，是 LZ-80 或柴油120。水平 900 m 是电动80，并且要电网。LZ-60 不会伸到那些格子。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Include the URL so HBT60-13.132 is not read as Diesel 60’s 35 m³/h. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请带上页面地址，避免把 HBT60-13.132 读成柴油60的 35 m³/h。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. Conveying distance is 100 m. Delivery height is 300 m.
answer.zh: 不是。输送距离是 100 m。输送高度是 300 m。

question.en: Does LZ-60 print a dual pressure mode?
question.zh: LZ-60 印了双压力模式吗？

answer.en: No. That split is on LZ-80. LZ-60 prints one output and one pressure: 50 m³/h and 35 MPa.
answer.zh: 没有。那种拆分在 LZ-80 上。LZ-60 印的是一个输送量和一个压力：50 m³/h 和 35 MPa。

answer.en: The scenario text includes rural and infrastructure placement, but the mass is 5500 kg. The compact rural diesel is 800 kg. Do not treat them as the same machine.
answer.zh: 工况文字包含农村与基建浇筑，但质量是 5500 kg。紧凑的农村柴油泵是 800 kg。不要当成同一台机器。

alt.zh: 邢台制造的 LZ-60 柴油混凝土泵，用于基建管路
